title: KHP07 10-round AES-192 / aes192-10r-rectangle-64-key-khp2007

target.description: 10 nonlinear AES rounds with the initial whitening addition and no final MixColumns. The recovered material is specified below.Output: whitening bytes 1,2,6,7,8,11,12,13 plus last-round K9 bytes 0,7,8,10,12,13; unknown key differences d,e,f are additionally enumerated. These are fourteen subkey bytes, not a recovered 192-bit master key.

setting.key_relation: Four groups of sixteen structured unknown keys, Section 4.3: bytes 3 and 11 are equal within each base key (s_i or t_j), distinct across each sixteen-key group; companion keys differ in bytes 1/9 and cross-groups in bytes 8/12.
setting.key_population: structured key sets satisfying the Section 4.3 equal-byte conditions
setting.plaintext_model: Chosen plaintexts aggregated across the 64 source-related keys; individual data points retain source average accounting.
assumptions: This is not unrestricted fixed-XOR related-key access: the prescribed within-key byte equalities and sixteen-key structures are required.

success.description: No numerical aggregate success is separately given for the64-key ten-round adaptation. Section4.3 forms256 structured key quartets and expects one to satisfy the unknown b condition; it does not quantify the chance of this event. The0.99 Poisson statement in Section4.2 belongs to the256-key/D2^125 procedure, not automatically to this64-key/D2^124 experiment. A mean-one compatible quartet is not1-exp(-1), and the structured quartets are not established independent.
